channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: U.S. cites barrels of oil escorted through Strait by military
item.description: The U.S. military has escorted one billion barrels of oil and over 2,000 commercial vessels out of the Persian Gulf in recent months.

item.title: Iran live updates: Ghalibaf says Strait of Hormuz closed until conditions met
item.description: President Donald Trump announced major combat operations against Iran on Feb. 28, accompanied by large joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine deployed new ballistic missile in major Moscow attack
item.description: Smoke was seen over Moscow Sunday morning following a Ukrainian drone and missile strike that hit a major oil refinery, among other targets.

item.title: Ukraine fires 1,000 drones at Russia, hundreds targeting Moscow
item.description: A local official said Sunday that the attack across the Moscow region killed two people and wounded 20.
